recipe.recipe: normal_entry once; normal_submit four repeats of both plain/history; correction once in both contexts; no new scenes
recipe.seed_selection: fixed first seed; retain all three, never select best test seed
recipe.normal_gate: all seeds and both contexts >= max(base_plain,history_plain) on validation normals and base_plain on Submit
recipe.correction_gate: all seeds target-last >= max(old history legacy,target-last) validation corrections
recipe.test_use: 8000 series locked in prior protocol; recipe fixed solely from 5000 validation, before inspecting 8000 scores; no retuning after test

limitations: 192 records reuse 72 original training scenes; repetition is not new data diversity.
Recipe and primary seed were fixed from original validation before reading 8000-series scores.
Mixture/context pairing and training prompt were jointly changed; do not attribute all effects to one field.
All three seeds are retained; primary seed was fixed in advance, not selected as the best performer.
Only primary seed has online execution acceptance; replicates are evaluated offline.
Failures are teacher/evaluator-selected; task transitions are scripted; not autonomous detection/planning.
Restarts are separate from in-place recovery; online checks reuse offline test scenes/candidates.
Small descriptive study, not a statistical non-inferiority or broad generalization claim.
Strict teacher-box hits and actual GUI success are distinct; boundary cases retain both original scores without post-hoc margin changes.
decision: Keep published defaults and base unchanged. Balanced adapters remain experimental and failed the validation gate; no further test-driven training or RL.
